results.title: Nosferatu
results.overview: An estate agent travels to the Carpathians to sell a house to the reclusive Count Orlok, who follows him home and brings a plague with him. F. W. Murnau’s silent classic of German Expressionism.

results.title: A Trip to the Moon
results.overview: A congress of astronomers fires itself to the Moon in a giant shell, meets its inhabitants and escapes back to Earth. Georges Méliès’ fourteen-minute fantasy, full of stage tricks.

results.title: The Great Train Robbery
results.overview: Bandits hold up a steam train, rob its passengers and flee on horseback, with a posse close behind. Edwin S. Porter’s twelve-minute western, an early landmark of film editing.

results.title: Intolerance
results.overview: Four stories from four eras, from the fall of Babylon to a modern city, are cut together to show how intolerance repeats through history. D. W. Griffith’s monumental silent epic.

results.title: Nanook of the North
results.overview: A year with an Inuk hunter and his family on the coast of Hudson Bay: building an igloo, fishing through the ice, trading at the post. Robert J. Flaherty’s early feature-length documentary.

results.title: Lanternfall
results.overview: When every lighthouse on a stormy coast goes dark on the same night, a young keeper sets out to learn who is switching them off.

results.title: The Salt Archive
results.overview: Two archivists catalogue the records of a drowned town and find that some of the letters are dated next week.

results.title: Kestrel Station
results.overview: The crew of a remote weather station keeps the forecasts coming while the storm outside starts answering back.
